opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 952.] Motion of respondent Maria Simpson for leave to proceed further herein informa pau-peris granted. Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that David A. Bono, Esq., of Washington, D. C., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondents Donald Simpson et al. in this case.
